race.comment: ARIANA REIGN (4) came second last at her first attempt but it was in provincial company and she wasn't beaten that far. Has had two trials to be ready for this and you would only need to see any sort of support to have some confidence of a good run. TIME FOR SPEED (2) tried hard at his first effort. It was on heavy going so must reconsider onto a better surface. Has trialled well since. KULDAR (1) will definitely be a betting watch on debut for the leading local stable. He draws well for that. POMELO CHAMOMILE (8) took on too tough a company seven weeks back. Had a let up and trial since then. Place some hope. ANOTHER SOIREE (3) has to be in the mix coming off metro trial form. Plenty of gear added for the first run.
